entries.name: EVENT_TYPES
entries.description: Map of all 16 event type string literals: ORDER_CREATED through ORDER_RETURN_REFUNDED, PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED/FAILED/REFUNDED, PRODUCT_CREATED/UPDATED/DELETED, SEARCH_EXECUTED

entries.name: TOPICS
entries.description: Kafka topic name constants: ORDER_EVENTS ('order.events'), PAYMENT_EVENTS ('payment.events'), PRODUCT_EVENTS ('product.events'), SEARCH_EVENTS ('search.events')

entries.name: CONSUMER_GROUPS
entries.description: Kafka consumer group constants: NOTIFICATION_WORKER ('notification-worker-group'), PRODUCT_SERVICE ('product-service-group'), PAYMENT_SERVICE ('payment-service-group'), ORDER_SERVICE ('order-service-group'), ANALYTICS_SERVICE ('analytics-service-group'), SEARCH_INDEXER ('search-indexer')

entries.name: BaseEventSchema
entries.description: Common base Zod schema for order and payment events: type (enum), orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)

entries.name: OrderItemSchema
entries.description: Zod schema for an order line item: productId (int+), quantity (int+), price (number+)

entries.name: OrderCreatedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: number+, shippingAddress?: string }

entries.name: OrderConfirmedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: number+, paymentId?: string }

entries.name: OrderShippedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { trackingNumber?: string, carrier?: string, estimatedDelivery?: datetime }

entries.name: OrderCancelledSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { reason: string, cancelledBy: 'user'|'system'|'admin', refundAmount?: number>=0, items?: OrderItem[], totalAmount?: number+, previousStatus?: 'created'|'confirmed' }

entries.name: OrderDeliveredSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: number+ }

entries.name: OrderReturnRequestedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { category: string, reason?: string, items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: number+ }

entries.name: OrderReturnApprovedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { items: OrderItem[] (min 1), totalAmount: number+ }

entries.name: OrderReturnRejectedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { adminReason: string }

entries.name: OrderReturnRefundedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { refundAmount: number+ }

entries.name: PaymentAuthorizedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { transactionId: string, amount: number+, currency: string }

entries.name: PaymentFailedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { reason: string, retryable: boolean }

entries.name: PaymentRefundedSchema
entries.description: Extends BaseEventSchema. data: { amount: number+, currency: string }

entries.name: ProductCreatedSchema
entries.description: Standalone schema (not extending BaseEventSchema). Fields: eventId (UUID), type ('product.created'), timestamp (ISO 8601), payload: { id (UUID), name, description, price, averageRating, categoryIds: string[], categoryNames: string[], tags: string[], inStock: boolean, imageUrl?: string, createdAt, updatedAt }

entries.name: ProductUpdatedSchema
entries.description: Standalone schema. Same structure as ProductCreatedSchema but type is 'product.updated'

entries.name: ProductDeletedSchema
entries.description: Standalone schema. Fields: eventId (UUID), type ('product.deleted'), timestamp (ISO 8601), payload: { id (UUID), deletedAt: datetime }

entries.name: SearchExecutedSchema
entries.description: Standalone schema. Fields: eventId (UUID), type ('search.executed'), timestamp (ISO 8601), payload: { query: string, resultCount: number, facetsApplied: Record<string, string[]>, userId?: string, responseTimeMs: number }

entries.name: createOrderEvent
entries.description: Overloaded factory for all 9 order event types. Params: (type, { orderId, userId, data, correlationId?, timestamp? }). Auto-generates correlationId (UUID v4) and timestamp (ISO 8601) if not provided. Throws ZodError on invalid input. Return type narrows to the specific event type based on the type argument.

entries.name: createPaymentEvent
entries.description: Overloaded factory for all 3 payment event types (PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED, PAYMENT_FAILED, PAYMENT_REFUNDED). Same auto-generation and throwing behavior as createOrderEvent.

entries.name: validateEvent
entries.description: Safe consumer-side validator. Signature: (event: unknown) => ValidationResult. Discriminates on event.type to select the correct schema. Never throws. Returns { success: true, data: AllEvents } or { success: false, error: Error }.

entries.name: createProductCreatedEvent
entries.description: Factory for product.created events. Accepts ProductCreatedEvent['payload']. Auto-generates eventId (UUID v4) and timestamp. Throws ZodError on invalid input.

entries.name: createProductUpdatedEvent
entries.description: Factory for product.updated events. Accepts ProductUpdatedEvent['payload']. Auto-generates eventId (UUID v4) and timestamp.

entries.name: createProductDeletedEvent
entries.description: Factory for product.deleted events. Accepts ProductDeletedEvent['payload'] ({ id, deletedAt }). Auto-generates eventId (UUID v4) and timestamp.

entries.name: createSearchExecutedEvent
entries.description: Factory for search.executed events. Accepts SearchExecutedEvent['payload']. Auto-generates eventId (UUID v4) and timestamp.

entries.name: EventType
entries.description: Union of all event type string literals derived from EVENT_TYPES values

entries.name: BaseEvent
entries.description: TypeScript type inferred from BaseEventSchema: { type, orderId, userId, correlationId, timestamp }

entries.name: OrderItem
entries.description: TypeScript type for order line items: { productId: number, quantity: number, price: number }

entries.name: Topic
entries.description: Union of Kafka topic string literals derived from TOPICS values

entries.name: ConsumerGroup
entries.description: Union of consumer group string literals derived from CONSUMER_GROUPS values

entries.name: OrderEvent
entries.description: Discriminated union of all 9 order event types

entries.name: PaymentEvent
entries.description: Discriminated union of all 3 payment event types

entries.name: ProductEvent
entries.description: Discriminated union of ProductCreatedEvent | ProductUpdatedEvent | ProductDeletedEvent

entries.name: SearchEvent
entries.description: Alias for SearchExecutedEvent

entries.name: AllEvents
entries.description: Discriminated union of OrderEvent | PaymentEvent | ProductEvent | SearchEvent — used as the return type of validateEvent on success

entries.name: ValidationResult
entries.description: { success: true, data: AllEvents } | { success: false, error: Error } — never-throwing result type from validateEvent

entries.baseFields: type, orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)
entries.description: Published by Order Service when an admin marks a shipped order as delivered. Starts the 30-day return window.

entries.baseFields: type, orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)
entries.description: Published by Order Service when an admin approves a return. Triggers inventory restoration in Product Service and refund creation in Payment Service.

entries.baseFields: type, orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)
entries.description: Published by Order Service when an admin rejects a return request. Terminal state.

entries.baseFields: type, orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)
entries.description: Published by Order Service after consuming payment.refunded. Terminal state of the return saga.

entries.baseFields: type, orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)

entries.baseFields: type, orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)
entries.description: Published by Payment Service on mock payment failure (10% probability).

entries.baseFields: type, orderId (int+), userId (int+), correlationId (UUID v4), timestamp (ISO 8601)
